sections.title: 1. Commitment to Equality
sections.content: Actors Theatre Rajasthan (ATR) is deeply committed to fostering an inclusive, welcoming, and equitable environment for all individuals. We believe that the transformative power of theatre is magnified when diverse voices, experiences, and backgrounds are respected and celebrated.

sections.title: 2. Non-Discrimination Statement
sections.content: ATR strictly prohibits and does not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or bullying of any kind. We do not discriminate on the basis of:
list: Race, ethnicity, color, or national origin
Gender, gender identity, or gender expression
Any other status protected by applicable local, state, or national laws

sections.title: 3. Scope of Policy
sections.content: This policy applies to all aspects of our organization's operations, including but not limited to:
list: Selection of vendors and collaborative partners
Provision of services and audience access

sections.title: 4. Reporting and Accountability
sections.content: Any individual who believes they have been subjected to discrimination or harassment at any ATR event, workshop, or workplace is encouraged to report the incident immediately. ATR is committed to investigating all such complaints promptly, confidentially, and impartially. Retaliation against any individual who reports discrimination in good faith is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: 5. Contact Us
sections.content: To report an incident or if you have questions regarding this policy, please contact our leadership team at:
list: Address: P-3 Kisan Marg, W-2, Madhuban Colony, Tonk Road, Jaipur – 302015, Rajasthan
